feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: After booting 760K off ACA health plans, the Trump administration adds some people back
entry.summary: The Trump administration provided few details about its process for canceling hundreds of thousands of Affordable Care Act enrollments — even as the next stage of the anti-fraud effort is underway.

entry.title: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries, officials say, after brief truce
entry.summary: Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia's Ryazan region early Thursday, hours after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over.

entry.title: Greetings from Mexico City, where a bullfighting ban doesn't stop this matador training
entry.summary: One plays the bull, the other the bullfighter, as a pair practices a dance of death in a sport that's prohibited in the Mexican capital city.

entry.title: Essential items to stock in your medicine cabinet for cold and flu season
entry.summary: Cold and flu season is here. Before someone in your household gets hit, make sure you have these essential meds and comfort items in your medicine cabinet.

entry.title: These swing voters regret voting for Trump and it's influencing their midterm choices
entry.summary: Some key voters in Georgia say deep frustration and disappointment with President Trump are motivating their election plans just weeks before Election Day.

entry.title: For some Christians, Hegseth's plan for public execution fits a biblical mandate
entry.summary: Defense Secretary Hegseth's announcement of a livestreamed execution elicited reactions of disgust and condemnation from some faith leaders and politicians. But within his church, it's not an outlier.

entry.title: School roof collapse kills at least 29, injures more than 3 dozen in Pakistan
entry.summary: The roof of a private school collapsed in northwestern Pakistan on Thursday, killing at least 28 children and a female teacher and injuring more than 50 other people.

entry.title: Aboard an icebreaker, a writer got a closer look at the Arctic's 'Sea Change'
entry.summary: As polar ice melts in the Arctic, shipping lanes are opening up, making the region a new zone of superpower competition. Writer Rana Foroohar explains the stakes in Sea Change.

entry.title: 'New Yorker' cartoonists admit to having 'The Two Saddest Kitchens'
entry.summary: The Two Saddest Kitchens is a comic conversation between Roz Chast and Jason Adam Katzenstein. Book critic Maureen Corrigan says it made her laugh and feel better about her own (lack of) cooking.

entry.title: Inflation sizzled in September — and Social Security benefits will get a boost
entry.summary: Consumer prices in September jumped 3.7% from a year ago. The Social Security Administration said benefits will increase next year to help keep pace with the rising cost of living.
